text_block_list.text:
During training, Maruzensky got injured,
so I brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow, ow... Even for me,
I might be feeling a bit groggy...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, I need to make sure I get back on track soon.
Time to show everyone my guts~!
choice_data_list: No need to rush, let's focus on getting you healed
Drastic times call for drastic measures!
Drastic times call for drastic measures!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, I need to make sure I get back on track soon.
Time to show everyone my guts~!
choice_data_list: No need to rush, let's focus on getting you healed
Drastic times call for drastic measures!
Drastic times call for drastic measures!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Really? As far as I'm concerned,
a little rest and it's problem-nothing, but—
choice_data_list: You'll be in real trouble if that injury gets worse!
It'll be really bad if your injury gets worse, you know.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
If we're gonna heal it, might as well make it purr-fect.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, to lift our spirits, why don't we stop by the convenience store and buy some Shiba-brand panna cotta?♪
choice_data_list: Huh? They didn't have that at the convenience store.
They didn't have that at the convenience store, you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Gah!!
Shiba-jirushi is only sold at supermarkets!?

To cheer up a downcast Maruzensky,
I headed to the supermarket to buy her
favorite panna cotta.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Mhm-mhm, let's do our best-est♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Sickness starts in the mind", so injuries must be the same!
Time to blast my favorite tracks and hype myself up~♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh?
My phone is gone?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Gah!!
Did I leave it in my room!?
choice_data_list: I'll play a song on my phone.
I'll play some music from my phone.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?
Thank you, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?
Thank you, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Then give me a super groovy, youthful track! Let's go-go♪

Hearing that, I put on a song popular with the youth,
but—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh, this is what's trending right now!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No way...!
I had no idea at all...

Shocked at having fallen behind the latest trends,
Maruzensky's recovery took a turn for the slower.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, cha-cha-cha♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~ What a great song after all.
It makes me wanna start dancing♪
choice_data_list: Don't get too carried away, alright?
Don't get too carried away, okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Loud and clear!

Perhaps thanks to moderate exercise,
Maruzensky's injury healed
much faster than expected.
